name: The Thandol Span
summary: Following a devastating explosion that rocked northern Wetlands, Rhag Garmason asks travelers to search the ruined bridges of the Thandol Span for a missing dwarf scout. The Dark Iron clan has launched a brutal assault against Dun Modr, cutting off communication and leaving local defenders stranded without reinforcements. Finding Ol' Rustlocke is the first step toward uncovering the full scale of the sabotage.

sections.title: Thunder Over the Span
sections.body: A catastrophic blast recently tore through the Thandol Span, shattering the massive stone bridge connecting the Wetlands to the Arathi Highlands. Bronzebeard soldiers stationed at the border were caught in the devastation as Dark Iron dwarves ambushed Dun Modr. With their ranks thinned and their strongholds besieged, the survivors under Longbraid the Grim have been forced into a desperate defensive holdout against the attackers.

sections.title: A Scout Sent East
sections.body: Hoping to salvage a crossing and determine whether any path northward remains usable, Longbraid dispatched the veteran scout Ebenezer Rustlocke to inspect the eastern span. Days passed without a single report, but with Dun Modr actively under siege, Rhag Garmason and the garrison lack the soldiers to launch a rescue expedition into enemy-controlled rubble.

sections.title: Grim Discovery
sections.body: Venturing out onto the shattered span reveals the cost of the Dark Iron assault. Far from returning with reconnaissance, Ol' Rustlocke was slain amidst the debris of the eastern bridge. His recovered body and belongings confirm the worst: the crossing is entirely compromised, and the Dark Irons are actively fortifying their hold on the vital artery between Khaz Modan and Lordaeron.

faq.answer: The Thandol Span is a colossal dwarven bridge structure that spans the chasm between the northern Wetlands and the Arathi Highlands. It serves as the primary land route connecting Khaz Modan to the northern lands of Lordaeron.

The Dark Iron dwarf clan attacked the bridge and the nearby outpost of Dun Modr. They detonated explosives to sever the span, crippling Alliance transit and catching the Bronzebeard defenders off guard.

Ebenezer Rustlocke was a trusted dwarven scout serving Longbraid the Grim. He was sent to assess the condition of the eastern bridge following the explosion, but he was overwhelmed and killed by Dark Iron forces during his mission.

Rhag Garmason is stationed near the beleaguered settlement of Dun Modr, just south of the Thandol Span in northern Wetlands. He helps coordinate defense efforts while the garrison is cut off from Ironforge.

faq.q: Why hasn't Ironforge sent help to Dun Modr?
faq.answer: The suddenness of the attack, combined with the destruction of the bridge and the siege of Dun Modr, has left the garrison isolated. The defenders are stretched too thin to send couriers or divert troops, leaving them dependent on passing adventurers to deliver word.

faq.q: What happens after finding Rustlocke's corpse?
faq.answer: Investigating Rustlocke's remains reveals notes and supplies detailing the extent of the Dark Iron sabotage. This begins an effort to disrupt the Dark Iron demolition operations on the bridge and ultimately seek broader aid through a plea to the Alliance leadership.

angles.text: The destruction of the Thandol Span is an affront to dwarven stonework and a direct strike against Khaz Modan by their hated Dark Iron kin.
The Thandol Span is the sole overland supply corridor linking Stormwind and Ironforge to Alliance forces holding out in Arathi and Hillsbrad.
